rival:all_odd_vertical:fixed_five.description: Mark every vertical blue component of odd size, ignoring the selected length.
rival:all_odd_vertical:fixed_five.name: all_odd_vertical
rival:all_odd_vertical:fixed_five.program:
(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let ([k 5])
      (for/fold ([out g])
                ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 1) (= (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)) (odd? (obj-size o))))
                              (objects g 0))])
        (let* ([ordered (sort-by (obj-cells obj)
                                (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) (cols g)) (second p))))]
               [p (nth ordered (quotient (- (obj-size obj) 1) 2))])
          (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 2))))))

rival:run_ignores_branches:fixed_five.description: Mark maximal vertical blue runs of the selected length, ignoring side branches.
rival:run_ignores_branches:fixed_five.name: run_ignores_branches
rival:run_ignores_branches:fixed_five.program:
(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let ([k 5])
      (for*/fold ([out g]) ([r (range (rows g))] [c (range (cols g))])
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 1)
                 (or (= r 0) (not (= (at g (- r 1) c) 1)))
                 (<= (+ r k) (rows g))
                 (andmap (lambda (dr) (= (at g (+ r dr) c) 1)) (range k))
                 (or (= (+ r k) (rows g))
                     (not (= (at g (+ r k) c) 1))))
            (set-cell out (+ r (quotient (- k 1) 2)) c 2)
            out)))))

setting:marker_size.program:
(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ([markers (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) (objects g 0))]
           [k (obj-size (first markers))])
      (for/fold ([out g])
                ([obj (filter (lambda (o)
                                (and (= (obj-color o) 1)
                                     (= (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o))
                                     (= (obj-size o) k)))
                              (objects g 0))])
        (set-cell out (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2)
                      (obj-c1 obj) 2)))))
